-Comp. 
-गुणः the quality of the womb or place of origin. 
-ज a. born of the womb, viviparous. 
-देवता the asterism पूर्बफल्गुनी. 
-दोषः 
__1 Sexual defilement. 
__2 A defect of the female organ. 
-नासा the upper part of the female organ. 
-भ्रंशः fall of the womb, prolapsus uteri. 
-मुक्त a. released from birth or being born again. 
-मुखम् the [Page1320-1] orifice of the womb. 
-मुद्रा a particular position of fingers. 
-रञ्जनम् the menstrual discharge. 
-लिङ्गम् the clitoris. 
-शस्या a Ṛgvedic verse which is both a योनि as well as a शस्या (q. v.); योनिशस्याश्च तुल्यवदितराभिर्विधीयन्ते [[

.]] 
-संवरणम्, -संवृत्तिः Contraction of the vagina. 
-संकटम् rebirth. 
-संकरः mixture of caste by unlawful intermarriage; कुले मुख्येऽपि जातस्य यस्य स्याद् योनिसंकरः [[
